title: Ragonia Modpack
description: Ragonia Modpack is a modpack to enhance minecraft in a way but still making it fun to play and chill.
body:
Ragonia Modpack

Ragonia Modpack is designed for the Ragonia SMP, enhancing the Minecraft experience with exploration, performance, and adventure upgrades — though it works perfectly for singleplayer too!

Want to join the Ragonia SMP?
 Check out RazixClaw’s YouTube channel for all server information.


---

 World & Terrain

Terralith and Biomes O’ Plenty bring hundreds of new and upgraded biomes.

YUNG’s mods overhaul structures like the Desert Temple, Witch Hut, End Portal Room, and Nether Fortress.

Repurposed Structures and Additional Structures fill your world with fresh exploration content.



---

 Gear & Loot

Lootr ensures each player gets their own unique loot.

Artifacts adds rare items only obtainable through exploration — not crafting.

Advanced Netherite introduces improved netherite tiers.

Immersive Armors adds variety and style to your combat gear.



---

 Gameplay & Features

Better Nether and Better End make both dimensions stunning and dangerous.

Traveler’s Backpack keeps your inventory mobile and organized.

Gravestones store your items safely when you die.

Guard Villagers protect villages from raids.

First Person Model for immersive visuals.

Elytra Slot — no more chestplate swapping!

Inventory Walk, Mouse Tweaks, and Pickup Notifier make gameplay smoother.



---

 Utility & Building

Macaw’s Mods: Doors, Bridges, Roofs, Fences, and Walls — all for creative building freedom.

Tree Harvester for easier woodcutting.

Waystones for quick travel.

Tool Leveling+ lets you upgrade enchantments beyond vanilla limits (Curse and Mending excluded).



---

 Performance & Experience

Sound Physics Remastered and Ambient Sounds for immersive audio.

Replay Mod for cinematic replays.

Includes performance optimizations for smoother gameplay overall.
